stem:
Pentagon \( PQRST \) was graphed on a coordinate grid. Pentagon \( PQRST \) was rotated 90° counterclockwise about the origin to form pentagon \( P'Q'R'S'T' \).
Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The area of pentagon \( P'Q'R'S'T' \) is not equal to the area of pentagon \( PQRST \).

options.label: B
options.text: Pentagon \( P'Q'R'S'T' \) is not congruent to pentagon \( PQRST \).

options.label: C
options.text: The perimeter of pentagon \( P'Q'R'S'T' \) is greater than the perimeter of pentagon \( PQRST \).

options.label: D
options.text: The angle measures of pentagon \( P'Q'R'S'T' \) are congruent to the corresponding angle measures of pentagon \( PQRST \).
